open: Lifts: Bane NOR says there is a lift to every platform, but the OSM extract has none, so positions and which passage exit serves which platform are unknown.
Stairs w58198084–w58198087: OSM does not link them to platform refs, and the extract has no platform objects; which island platform each reaches is unknown.
Signposted names for the levels and for the passage under the tracks not found; no heights in any source.

Shop positions for the passage are inferred from OSM coordinates (distance to the middle of the underpass), not from a plan or owner text. No Bane NOR/Bane NOR Eiendom tenant list or station plan found.

Hours missing for: Narvesen n710551047, Go' Bento, Big Bite, toilets. Narvesen's store finder (3 stores: Lillestrøm jbst., Lillestrøm jbst. syd, Rutebilst. Lillestrøm) did not render hours; which OSM node matches which store is not established.
All shop hours except Backstube come from OSM's opening_hours only (shops' own sites not found or not readable); they may be outdated.
Ticket machine positions (5 machines) not given. Messesiden bike hotel is not in the OSM extract.
Which OSM entrance is the station hall door is not established; many OSM entrances along Jonas Lies gate (n6847210341–n6847224699, n1243723632–36) probably belong to the bus terminal building.

answers.question: (no open-question list for Norway; levels, ways to the platforms, entrances and shops requested)
answers.answer: Station hall in the 1930 building on Jonas Lies gate (bysiden) with the bus terminal next to it; a passage under the tracks (OSM w25123510, ~104 m) holds several eateries and shops and leads to four island platforms (spor 1/2, 3/4, 6/7, 8/9). Bane NOR confirms stairs and a lift to every platform; OSM maps four stairs off the passage but no lifts. 18 shops/eateries/services listed from OSM, with hours from OSM except Backstube (own website).
answers._source: Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-l-/lillestrom/, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_no/NO-LLS.json), read 2026-10-30; Backstube, Visit us https://backstube.no/visit-us, read 2026-10-30
